column3: Lesson three. One person can change the story.
At the end of that first episode, someone finally sees Naruto. His teacher, Iruka, puts himself between Naruto and danger, and tells him he isn't the monster. He's one of them.
Later, Naruto meets Gaara. A boy carrying the same kind of burden, who grew up just as alone. Gaara pushed everyone away. Naruto kept reaching out.
After their fight, Naruto tells Gaara he understands that pain. And slowly, Gaara starts to change. Years later, his whole village welcomes him home.
Even earlier, another character tells Naruto that people become truly strong when they have someone precious to protect.
Connection didn't make Naruto's pain disappear. It gave it somewhere to go.
